set.body:
Run the existing Studio golden study at frozen replication scales through public study APIs, with every result/diagnostic materialized and exported. Use actual core computation rather than the mock study scores. Freeze source/input/config identities, pair counts and result digests; integrate with real Studio backend ownership.

Bounded adapter slice using docs/plans/PYMOVEMENTS_PERFORMANCE.md and the PM3.2 collector. Acceptance: source/data/config-bound raw receipts for all declared scales and modes; deliberate wrong-output and failed-process cases rejected; no budget relaxation after results. Run relevant correctness checks. Split before implementation if more than roughly half a day. This adapter alone cannot close PM3.
set.title: PM3.14 Record complete study execution and materialization budgets
